# Capability index

<!-- Generated by scripts/capabilities.py — do not edit by hand. -->

Every public name in finitevolX (338 of them), each listed once,
grouped by the module that defines it (names re-exported from
spectraldiffx and gaussx are grouped by library), with the first
sentence of its docstring; then the public API of spectraldiffx and
gaussx, which finitevolX builds on. Search this page before writing a
helper: if what you need is here, compose it; if it is almost here,
extend it where it lives. Regenerate with `make capabilities` after
changing a public API (`tests/test_capabilities.py` checks it is
current).

Listed at spectraldiffx 0.0.13, gaussx 0.0.17.

## Upstream: `spectraldiffx`

Spectral transforms (DCT / DST / FFT), the rectangular spectral Poisson / Helmholtz solvers and their eigenvalues, and the spectral capacitance solver. finitevolX re-exports most of the solver API (listed above); the rest — spectral derivatives, spherical-harmonic and Chebyshev machinery — is used from here, never re-implemented.

## Upstream: `gaussx`

Structured linear algebra and solver strategies. finitevolX delegates the tridiagonal solve and the Nyström preconditioner to it; use it for any other structured solve, preconditioner or low-rank approximation instead of writing one here.
